text: 🇲🇽🌎 "USMCA is law. The treaty benefits all three countries." "USMCA is law. The treaty benefits all three countries. There are things we don't agree on, but the dialogue is open — and Mexico's position is clear: we defend our industry, our sovereignty, and our workers." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on T-MEC and Trump Mexico's negotiating team is working with US and Canadian counterparts. A Sheinbaum–Trump call is on the table once technical talks advance — but the floor is non-negotiable: industry, sovereignty, workers.

🇲🇽✊ Housing for the Pueblo — by the numbers. "274,000 homes under construction. 604,000 contracted. 24,500 delivered. 63.4% of regularization titles are in women's names. 75% of those buying are under 40. Sexenio goal: 1.8 million homes." — Vivienda para el Bienestar report, June 15 mañanera Conavi, Infonavit, and Insus reported together. Infonavit restructured 4.9 million predatory mortgages — 457,000 now at zero balance. Beneficiaries earn 1–2 minimum salaries. The largest public housing build in Mexican history is rolling.

🇲🇽🌎 "Whenever peace is built in the world, we celebrate it." "Whenever peace is built in the world, we celebrate it. We hope this agreement is really signed this week." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on the US-Iran agreement Oil dropped from $100 to ~$80/barrel as the Strait of Hormuz reopens. Mexico is currently absorbing part of the gasoline price through IEPS subsidies — a cheaper barrel means breathing room for both the federal budget and household economies across the world.

🇲🇽✊ "All discrimination must be eradicated." "Racism, classism, machismo — all discrimination must be eradicated from society. Every one of us is equal." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on World Cup incidents After reports of racist and classist conduct at World Cup matches, the line is clean: this is the country's chance to show the best of Mexico, not to reproduce historic inequalities.

🇲🇽⚽ "FIFA has to reflect. Football should not only be a business." "FIFA has to reflect — football should not only be a business. It's the people's passion. There has to be access for everyone, not just those who can pay." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on World Cup 2026 Mexico set up free public-square screenings and "Social World Cup" tournaments so the games reach everyone, not just those who can afford the gate price. The 4T frames sport as a right of the pueblo, not a luxury good.

🇲🇽⚖️ Containment is not repression. "Containing is very different from repressing. Mexico City's police have a lot of experience in containment — which is very different from hitting, repressing, and violating human rights." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on CNTE protests Asked whether the government would use force against teachers' union mobilizations, the answer was no. The 4T came out of social struggle. The reform conversation continues through the permanent technical roundtable and the school-by-school consultation in August.

🚨🇲🇽 On the US drug czar's threats: "Cooperation without subordination — always." "They know our position. Our position is firm in defense of sovereignty, in cooperation without subordination — always." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, June 15 mañanera Asked about US drug czar Sara Carter's threats to "attack the cartels" and target Mexican officials, Sheinbaum refused to debate her. The line on reciprocity stays: if Mexico fights drugs going north, the US has to fight guns going south.

🇲🇽📊 PESO HITS 17.17 — STRONGEST SINCE FEBRUARY AS OIL DROPS 5%

The Iran-US peace deal is already moving Mexico's numbers. Peso at 17.17 per dollar — strongest since February 20, up 0.34%. WTI crude down 5.1% to $80.55, Brent down 4.31% to $83.57. Hormuz reopening floods the market.

Japan's Nikkei surged 5.49%, S&P futures up 1.17%. Mexico enters TMEC Round 2 tomorrow with record $50.7B monthly exports, $23.6B FDI, and inflation at 3.94%.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 ISRAEL KILLS 5 MORE IN LEBANON — 3,756 DEAD SINCE MARCH

While the US negotiates peace with Iran, Israel keeps bombing Lebanon. Five killed today including Ali Badie, mayor of Ar-Rihan. Since March 2: 3,756 dead and 11,632 wounded.

Israel ordered 24 communities south of the Zahrani River to evacuate. Hezbollah downed an Israeli Hermes 450 drone and struck military positions. The "ceasefire" exists only on paper.

🚨🌎 EBOLA SURGES TO 782 CASES — NO VACCINE FOR THIS STRAIN

The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda has hit 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths — up 46% in just eight days. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo variant. WHO declared it a global health emergency on May 17.

Mexico activated health filters at all entry points. Sheinbaum ordered "special sanitary measures to guarantee diseases will not spread." The DRC national team is in Guadalajara for the World Cup right now.
